wiki.title: Mike Bernskoetter
wiki.extract: Mike Bernskoetter (born November 29, 1959) is an American politician. He is a member of the Missouri Senate from the 6th district, serving since 2019. He previously represented the 59th district in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2011 to 2019. He is a member of the Republican Party.
